sections.en: 2 τηρῶν τόπον τῶν ('watching the place of the') omitted by M. τὸν ('the') I have supplied; "tendens ad locum cum rama" Albumasar. 3 διότι - Σκορπίος ('because - Scorpio') omitted by M. Σκορπίος ('Scorpio') omitted by P : I have supplied. 4 ἡ γυνή ('the woman') P. μέσης ('middle') P M : corrected by Cumont. εὐπρεπείας ('of good appearance') M. 5 σκευρινόν ('equipment') P : in the margin by the second hand ἴσως σκευάριον ('perhaps a small vessel') (which is found in M). 7 ἡ χρ. αὐτ. χρυσῆ ('its color golden') M. 10 οἶκος - ἄνθρωπος ('house - man') I have supplied. 11 ἐστι ('is') omitted by M. οἱ ('the') omitted by P. 12 κλίνον ('bed') P. πέδουκλα καὶ ('hooves and') I have bracketed. 13 καὶ πέδουκλα ἀλόγων ('and hooves of horses') omitted by M. The word πέδουκλον ('hoof') from this place Meursius received in his glossary p. 527, who writes these things: Πέδουκλον ('hoof'), Pedungula, Ungula pedis. Achmes in the introduction to the Mathem. μορφὴ ὡς συάγρου, ὀδόντες ὡς τριβόλοι, ἔχων πέδουκλα ἀλόγων ('form like a wild boar, teeth like caltrops, having hooves of horses'). 14 διότι - Ταῦρος ('because - Taurus') omitted by M. 15 λεοπάρδια ('leopards') P. παλλίον κεκομμένα ('cloak cut') M. 17 διότι - Παρθένος ('because - Virgo') omitted by M. 18 τῇ θεωρίᾳ ('in appearance') omitted by M. 19 κοινῶν ('common') M. 21 τάπος ('carpet') P. 23 διότι - Δίδυμος ('because - Gemini') omitted by M. 24 τοῦ προσώπου ('of the face') and μορφή ('form') and αὐτοῦ ('his') omitted by M. μορφὴ οἴκου ('form of a house') P M : ἵππου ('of a horse') corrected from Albumasar. 25 πλῆρες βολίδων ('full of missiles') M. δὲ ('but') omitted by M. βαστάζων ('carrying') M. 26 ἀπὸ ('from') omitted by M. 27 διότι - Ζυγός ('because - Libra') omitted by M. 29 ὀπῶν ('of sap') : "resina" Albumasar. 30 σίδηρα ('iron tools') P. ὑπ’ αὐτὸν ('under him') I have written : ὑπαύγων ('under the rays') P; omitted by M. καὶ ἐρχόμενος ('and coming') : "Laborans ut loco transmutet" Albumasar.

summary.headline: Sagittarius, Capricorn, and Aquarius Decans
summary.text: Descriptions of the second and third decans of Sagittarius, all three decans of Capricorn, and all three decans of Aquarius, including their planetary rulers, zodiacal houses, and human or animal figures with characteristic objects, clothing, colors, and activities.
